zh: 合并规则就是按下标交替：先取a的第i个字符，再取b的第i个字符；某个串在该下标已经没有字符时直接跳过，剩余部分就自然被追加在后面。
两个串都可能含空格，也可能是空串，所以必须按整行读取，不能按空白切分，输出时也要原样保留空格。
读出两行a和b，下标i从0遍历到两串长度的较大值：若i小于a的长度就追加a的第i个字符，若i小于b的长度再追加b的第i个字符；最后把结果作为一整行输出。
en: The merge rule is simply alternating by index: take the i-th character of a, then the i-th character of b; when a string has no character at that index, skip it, and the rest of the other string is appended naturally.
Both strings may contain spaces or be empty, so read whole lines instead of splitting on whitespace, and keep the spaces unchanged in the output.

Read the two lines a and b and let i run from 0 up to the longer length: if i is less than the length of a append a's i-th character, then if i is less than the length of b append b's i-th character; finally print the result as one line.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Iterate over indices up to the longer length, checking and appending the corresponding characters of the two strings in turn.

## Proof of correctness

Each round appends exactly the next unprocessed characters, a first and then b, skipping a missing one; so each string keeps its own order, and both the interleaving rule and the rule for the remaining part are satisfied.

## Complexity

Time O(|a|+|b|), output space O(|a|+|b|).
